material_finding.finding: The repaired claim is bidirectional but the new NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY and other semantic nuisance controls are evaluated only at +control orientation. A4 specificity uses min(m(+ACTIVE)-m0, m0-m(-ACTIVE)), yet next_divergent_action_only_shift is only abs(m(+A4_ONLY)-m0). A5 specificity similarly uses qA(+ACTIVE) and qB(-ACTIVE), but unrelated/action-history/deranged/A4-only nuisance terms use +control for both qA and qB. Therefore a sign-asymmetric matched null can be strong in the omitted negative orientation while appearing weak under the frozen nuisance maximum.
material_finding.required_repair: Prospectively evaluate every orientation-bearing semantic nuisance used to certify bidirectional specificity in both signs, or freeze an explicitly justified sign-matched equivalent. At minimum NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY must evaluate + and - for the A4 primary and sign-match + on A-branch / - on B-branch for A5; safest frozen nuisance is the maximum absolute shift over both signs (and both branch states for A5). Apply the same orientation-robust rule to UNRELATED_PAIR_RESIDUAL, ACTION_HISTORY_MATCHED_NULL and FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED unless a deterministic scientific reason for a single sign is preregistered. Update nuisance formulas/tests only; do not change population, model/runtime, pair generation, grid, thresholds, split locks, A5 co-primary requirement or confirmation access.
material_finding.why_material: The original defect was specifically that exact A4/B4 identity could explain ACTIVE. A one-sided A4-only control does not rule out that explanation for the -ACTIVE/B branch, and the same asymmetry can understate new A5 co-primary nuisances. This can change a pass/fail outcome at the frozen 0.05 threshold.

scope: PRE_SCIENCE_ONLY; this review authorizes no engineering execution or Experiment registration until repaired and independently re-reviewed.
